decisions.reason: As a multi-model line extension in the core drainage range, the black-finish series now carries additional sunk investment and supports the firm's public design-led positioning, so management is likely to retain it and treat any weak demand as temporary.
This shower channel remains tightly aligned with the firm's core offer and its dedicated presentation signals visible commitment, making withdrawal within the next year unlikely.

The pump-assisted drainage line is more specialized but it fits the firm's future-ready bathroom strategy and accumulated investment, so management is inclined to continue backing it rather than reverse course quickly.

Although newly launched, this pump-drain shower channel was given a stand-alone market presence and reinforces the firm's declared innovation path, which encourages management to give it more time before considering withdrawal.
